summary: Explains how to set and understand the active session in the ERP, which determines the default academic year displayed upon logging in or switching entities.
steps: Locate the desired session in the list.
Click the star icon (labeled "Active Session") next to the session in the 'Action' column.
business_rules: The active session is the default session that opens when you log in or switch to a specific entity.
Only one session can be marked as active at a time for an entity.
important_notes: Even if multiple sessions exist, only the active one will open by default.
Users can manually switch to other sessions if needed, but the active session is the system's default.
questions: What is an active session in the ERP?
How do I set the default academic session for my institution?
Where can I see which session is currently active?
